title: Skywatcher sees orange orbs over Picatinny Arsenal during the New Jersey drone wave

tellings.quote: So that being said, we show up in New Jersey first night on location within 30 minutes over Pikatin Arsenal. Wopw all these orange orbs come into existence right over Pikatini Arsenal.

plain: In 2024, while people across New Jersey were reporting strange drones in the night sky, orange balls of light appeared over Picatinny Arsenal, a military base in the state. Jake Barber, a helicopter pilot who says he once carried a UFO with his helicopter, tells Michels that he and his team arrived on their first night and within 30 minutes saw "all these orange orbs come into existence right over" the base.
